global_structure_review.notes: Graph has the four frozen H roots and one R001 producer directly outputting P; there are no D or M propositions and no source applications to review. The single inference is not mathematically sufficient. In R001 S002, the claimed matrix-unit identity X_(lambda-i) E_(lambda,lambda)=E_(i,lambda) is false in general: on e_lambda, the supplied S001 formula gives coefficient binom(2(lambda-i),lambda-i), not 1. For example lambda=2,p=3,i=0 gives coefficient 6, which is not a unit in Z_(3) and is zero after reduction mod 3. Consequently the stated conclusion that every matrix unit is in the R-algebra generated by divided powers does not follow. S003 depends on those matrix units preserving M_R, and S005 depends on the resulting matrix units acting on the reduction; those steps are not established. Thus AND-closure to P fails. This is an inference-body mathematical review finding, not a claim that the target theorem is false. No per-inference packet replay is claimed.
